name: Build an Airbnb guest-feedback review queue with Apify and Google Sheets

nodes.name: Upsert review queue in Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Build an Airbnb guest-feedback review queue

Review recent guest feedback in one spreadsheet. Hosts and property managers can identify low ratings without an observed public host response, read the original review and decide what deserves personal attention. No AI account is required, and the workflow never posts replies.

### How it works
One Apify run reads up to 25 recent reviews from a public listing. It includes ratings and public host responses, without reviewer profile fields. Verified rows receive a review-priority label based only on the observed rating and response. Missing ratings are flagged for checking instead of treated as negative. A stable listing-and-review key updates the same Sheet row on repeats. CAPPED means a recent sample, not the full review history. Older observations remain in the Sheet with their last observation time; absence from a later sample never proves deletion. Failed source or billing checks stop delivery.

### Setup
1. Create an Apify Header Auth credential: name Authorization, value Bearer followed by your token. Select it on all four HTTP nodes.
2. Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 on the delivery node. Create an Airbnb Feedback tab using the supplied CSV headers.
3. Enter your spreadsheet ID and one public listing URL in Review settings. The example listing demonstrates the format and is not our property.
4. Run manually, then filter reviewPriority for LOW_RATING_NO_RESPONSE. Read the context before deciding whether to respond on Airbnb.
5. Repeat sequentially. Each delivered review is billable again. The default $0.15 Actor charge cap is a limit, not an estimate. No credits or Telegram notifications are included.

## 1. Configure
Set one public Airbnb listing and your Sheet destination. Invalid URLs and missing destinations stop before paid work.

## 2. Read recent reviews
Start one bounded Actor run. Poll the same run until complete; never automatically retry the paid start.

## 3. Verify the sample
Reconcile coverage, review identities and billing. CAPPED is a bounded recent window. Source failures stop delivery.

## 4. Review guest feedback
Update one row per listing and review. Filter priority labels for human review. Public response presence is an observation, not a guarantee that a response is needed.
